descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-13 Previous Notes · S21 「读照片：时间、哪个 AI 跑的、值和印的一样，跑 10 次」 Photo read: time, which AI ran, and values as printed, 10 runs

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T4 A photographed prior note is read by Google Gemini Flash via Vertex AI. The prototype's photo-reading instruction text is used word for word with only the request format adapted, and the read text ke …（TFA-94425 AC 1；TFA-94425 AC 2；TFA-94425 AC 3；TFA-94425 AC 4）
  • U13b Each photo read (photo capture) records which AI model ran it, with providerMs logged separately from durationMs.（UAT 3.9；UAT 3.5；TFA-94425 AC 1）

测试设计方法：性能（performance） — 量时间，看是不是在要求的秒数里。

Given The S03 synthetic note image

When Send the image through ai/vision:scanPriorNote 10 times as the signed-in test physician

Then Every call leaves a diagnostics row with model, durationMs and providerMs. The model is a Gemini Flash model on Vertex. The read text carries the printed values. Calls over 30 s are listed for review

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Deterministic: one log row per call with model, durationMs and providerMs (U13b, 3.9); the photo model names Gemini Flash (T4); the read text contains 'creatinine 1.1', 'BNP 1250', 'EF 30%' (T4). Timing is a target, not pass/fail: runs over 30 s are listed under 'needs review' without changing the verdict (3.5, Q10). …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 PERF · 性能计时；矩阵里排的车道 AI 检查（automated）

S21 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-13.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：PERF · 性能计时；辅助：CONFIG · 配置核对 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
